prompt_text: Who is the best roofing company in Dallas for a roof replacement?
answer_verbatim:
Short answer: there isn’t a single objectively “best” roofing company for every Dallas roof replacement — the right one depends on your needs (budget, roof type, warranty, whether you’re making an insurance claim, timeframe). I can help you pick the best option for your situation, or evaluate quotes you’ve received.

How to find the best roofer in Dallas
- Verify credentials
  - Proof of general liability insurance and workers’ compensation (or a clear explanation if a company is exempt)
  - Long-standing local presence and local references (not only storm-chaser crews)
  - Manufacturer-certified installer status for the shingle/roof system you want (this affects warranty)
- Reputation and references
  - Check recent Google/Yelp/Angi/Better Business Bureau reviews and ask the company for 3 local references from similar jobs
  - Look for consistent positive reviews and quick responses to any complaints
- Warranties and materials
  - Compare manufacturer product warranties and the contractor workmanship warranty length and whether it’s transferable
  - Ask what specific materials (brand, model, warranty) they will install
- Price and written estimate
  - Get at least 3 detailed, written estimates that break out labor, materials, disposal, permits, and any upgrades (ice-and-water shield, ridge vents, drip edge)
  - Beware of extremely low bids — they often mean corners cut or surprise change orders
- Permits, cleanup and timeline
  - Confirm who will pull permits (contractor should do this), how long the job will take, and cleanup expectations
- Insurance-claim experience (if applicable)
  - If you’re filing a claim, choose a roofer experienced handling claims and working with adjusters

Red flags
- No proof of insurance or unwillingness to provide certificates
- High-pressure sales tactics (demand immediate signing, “special storm” pricing)
- No local references or only out-of-area crews
- Vague or oral-only estimates

If you want specific company names
- Tell me your Dallas zip code, whether the project is residential or commercial, and whether you’re using insurance. I’ll then:
  - Give a short list of well-reviewed local roofers to consider (based on local review platforms and certifications)
  - Or help you compare any written estimates you already have

Would you like me to recommend local companies? If so, please share your zip code and a couple of details (residential vs. commercial, roof type, insurance claim or not).
